paite: Huan TOUPA min a athilhih tungtang thu a Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpinu'n ana zak in thuhaksa pipi toh amah ettel tum in akiang ah ahoh hi.
heading: Sheba Kumpinu Hong Vehna / (2 Kro 9.1-12)

paite: Jerusalem ah nungzui mi tampi toh, gimlimte leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua sangawngsaute tonpih in ahoh hi. Solomon kiang atun in alungtang a thu a pai tengteng suahkhe vek in ahoupih hi.
Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a; kumpipa theih louh, ahilhchet theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pildan tengteng, a-inn lam,
adohkan a nek ding, asikhate tutdan, anasemte nasepdan, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite, TOUPA' inn a lat halmang thillatte amuh in lungsim chih leng nei zou lou khop in lamdang asa hi.
Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildante ka gam a ka zak thuthang adik mah ana hi.
Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen uh ka taksang kei hi. Huchi in ngai in, akimkhat leng ahon na hilh sam ua, agen uh ka zak sang in na pildan leh na hoihdan ana thupizaw hi.
Na mite, hiai na sikha, na kiang a om gige na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete ahampha uhi!

TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak mahmah, Israelte laltutphah a hon tusakpa phat in om hen. TOUPA'N Israelte tangtawn in a-it a, huaiziak in, diktattak a vaihawm ding in kumpipa in ahon bawl hi," achi hi.
Huchi in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim atam a tam leh suangmantamte kumpipa apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang lawmlawm a tam alut ngei kei hi.
Hiram longhon, Ophir a pan dangka-eng va pote'n leng Ophir a pan almug sing tampi leh suangmantamte ahon pua uhi.

Kumpipa'n almug singte TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding in leh lasa mite kaihging leh pekging bawlna ding in azang hi. Tuni tan in hichibang almug sing himhim alut in, muh leng muh ahi nawnta kei hi.
Anget louh Solomon in apiakte chih louh leng kumpipa Solomon in Sheba kumpinu'n adeih tengteng, anget peuhmah apia hi. Huchi in amah leh lawite a-omna gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Hauhsakna / (2 Kro 9.13-29)

paite: Hiaite lou leng sumsin mite leh thilzuak mite, Arab kumpipate leh gamsung vaihawmte a pan siahpiakte anei lai hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekpek in lum lian zanih abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk alut hi.
Dangka-eng sekpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng mina thum alut a; huaite kumpipa'n Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
Kumpipa'n saiha laltutphah thupi mahmah abawl a, huai dangka-eng hoihpen tui in aluan hi.
Laltutphah kaltouhna ah siksan guk a-om a, laltutphah nunglam dawn abem hi. Atutna sik tuak ah douna a-om tuaktuak a; adouna zulte ah humpinelkai dingh lim nih a-om hi.
Siksan gukte sik tuak ah humpinelkai dingh sawm-le-nih lim a-om a; huchibang koi gam mah ah leng abawl ngei kei uhi.
Kumpipa nou tengteng dangka-eng ahi vek a, Lebanon gammang inn a, atui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng ngen mah ahi vek uhi. Dangka himhim a-om kei. Solomon dam lai in huai bangpi in asim kei uh.
Kumpipa'n tuipi ah Hiram longhon kithuahpih Tarshish longhon anei a; Tarshish longhon in kum thum hal zel in dangka-eng, dangka, saiha, zawng leh utong ahon po zel uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung a kumpipa tengteng hauh lam leh pil lam in akhup vek hi.
Pathian in alungtang a pilna thu akoihsak ngaikhe ding in leitung a mi tengteng in Solomon ahong zuan huthut zel uhi.
Michih in thilpiakte kum teng a piak zah nei in dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puan, galvan, gimlim, sakol leh sabiltungnoute ahong pe zel uhi.

Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a, kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi. Huaite kangtalai koihnate ah, Jerusalem a kumpipa omna ah a-omsak hi.
Kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah atam mahmah ziak in dangka chite suang bang mai a sehkhop in a-omsak a, sidar singte phai a theipi sing bang lel a sehkhop in a-omsak hi.
Solomon neih sakolte Aigupta gam a pan ahon tolhkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in ana khak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.

Aigupta gam a kangtalai dangka chi shekel zaguk zel in leh sakol dangka chi shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in ahon polut uhi. Huchibang mah in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate a ding in leng apokhia uhi.
